svg.title: Gold cycle pins - three candidate sets (BTC method: exact daily CLOSE extremes, one per primary turn, +-45d, scoring target only) - AWAITING OWNER APPROVAL
svg.desc: These windows are a SCORING TARGET for indicator weights, not execution periods. cycle_windows.py: "Documented per-asset cycle extrema for Stage A weight search. ... the optimizer must not invent ad-hoc peak/trough lists." They carry NO exposure floor and say nothing about time in market.
svg.text: Gold cycle pins - three candidate sets (BTC method: exact daily CLOSE extremes, one per primary turn, +-45d, scoring target only) - AWAITING OWNER APPROVAL
Which set becomes SdcaCycleWindows.gold_v1? A = strict BTC-parallel | B = +2 intermediate bear lows | C = + GFC pair
Set A +-45d scoring bands: red = peak, green = trough
B - A = the two intermediate bear lows A skips
C - B = the GFC pair (2008 high, then 2008 washout)
shipped pins in A, B and C: none (struck through)
2026-09-29 is the shipped "incomplete top"; the real 2026 high is 2026-01-29
Candidate sets (all pins are exact daily CLOSE extremes of GLD-USD.csv)
A - strict BTC-parallel, 6 pins = 3 peaks / 3 troughs, one per primary turn 2011 -> 2026
B - A + 2 intermediate bear lows (2013-12-19, 2018-08-16), 8 pins = 3 peaks / 5 troughs
C - B + the GFC pair (2008-03-17 peak, 2008-11-12 trough), 10 pins = 4 peaks / 6 troughs
BTC reference (display only): btc_v1() = 5 pins (3 peaks / 2 troughs), 2017-12-17 -> 2025-01-20, +-45d
These windows are a SCORING TARGET for indicator weights, not execution periods. cycle_windows.py: "Documented
per-asset cycle extrema for Stage A weight search. ... the optimizer must not invent ad-hoc peak/trough lists." They
carry NO exposure floor and say nothing about time in market.
AWAITING OWNER APPROVAL - no set is written to cycle_windows.py by this script
